subject: ANY AIRCRAFT OPERATED BY AN AIR TRANSPORT UNDERTAKING HOLDING
text:
A4609/26 NOTAMR A2588/26
Q) LRBB/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/4501N02531E234
A) LRBB B) 2608191120 C) 2611192359EST
E) ANY AIRCRAFT OPERATED BY AN AIR TRANSPORT UNDERTAKING HOLDING
   A VALID OPERATING LICENCE OR EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY THE COMPETENT
   AUTHORITIES OF BELARUS, INCLUDING AS A MARKETING CARRIER IN
   CODE-SHARING OR BLOCKED-SPACE ARRANGEMENTS, ARE PROHIBITED TO
   TAKE OFF FROM, LAND IN OR OVERFLY THE ROMANIAN TERRITORY EXCEPT
   IN THE CASE OF AN EMERGENCY LANDING OR AN EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT.
